verdict.rationale: Rootly AI SRE investigates active alerts and incidents, tests likely causes against live evidence, and returns a reviewable diagnosis. Investigation rules set which alerts it investigates automatically, so it can start before a human asks. It analyzes code changes, telemetry (e.g., AWS CloudWatch via connectors), and past incidents through related-incident matching and memory. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of investigation quality, and in-depth docs on change/deploy correlation (the code-change analysis rests mainly on a marketing page and a brief connectors mention).
